rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources
rules.requirement: Any landlord who plans to end a tenancy must give the tenant the City's Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit or notice of lease non-renewal. A violation does not stop the eviction process.
rules.key_value: Notice delivered with notice to quit / non-renewal; fine: warning, then $300 per day
rules.coverage_conditions: All landlords in Boston who plan to end a tenancy agreement, via notice to quit or notice of non-renewal of lease.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Triggered only when the landlord serves a notice to quit or notice of non-renewal of lease.

rules.penalty: Enforced by Inspectional Services Department: 1st offense warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses $300 per day. Violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.citation: Boston City Code § 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
rules.conflict_note: The page does not give an effective or enactment date. The citation 'Sec. 10-11.7' is taken from the page's penalty table and may refer to the penalty provision rather than the full ordinance.

rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice to Quit / Non-renewal submission to City
rules.requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners must submit the Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form through the City's online portal. The submission includes tenant contact information and a copy of the notice to quit or non-renewal.
rules.key_value: Fine up to $300 per day for failure to submit
rules.coverage_conditions: All landlords and foreclosing owners in Boston serving a notice to quit or notice of non-renewal of lease.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Triggered only when a notice to quit or notice of non-renewal of lease is served.

rules.penalty: Failure to submit may result in a fine of up to $300 per day.
rules.citation: Boston City Code § 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
rules.quoted_span: Landlords must use this online form to provide tenant contact information and upload a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
rules.conflict_note: The page does not give an effective or enactment date. The citation is taken from the page's penalty table.
